_envelope_comment: Derived from the Modesto, CA MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 1 MSA county (Stanislaus)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 16 geocoded venue(s) of 19 in this batch (observed lat 37.4698..37.7823, lng -121.1386..-120.7608).
